verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside GrowthBook that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server lets external AI tools such as Cursor and Claude call GrowthBook's REST API, which is an integration for outside agents rather than an in-product assistant. The 'AI Visual Editor' is only named, with no description of it taking delegated tasks, so it counts as an adjacent feature at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
